recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-47242 unless a future OO decision changes which NutritionProduct characteristics should be standard search parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-47242 was an Applied, Persuasive with Modification R6 OO change request asking for new NutritionProduct search parameters. The accepted disposition kept existing lotNumber and identifier parameters, added ingredients.item, added instance.expiry as a parameter named expiration-date with expression NutritionProduct.instance.expiry, and declined characteristics.type, characteristics.value, and instance.biologicalSourceEvent as standard search parameters.
initial_application: Commit d0f9f0cb921ca73af9137792711cb1d73df8e5c1 added NutritionProduct-ingredient-item and NutritionProduct-expiration-date to source/nutritionproduct/bundle-NutritionProduct-search-params.xml as part of a multi-issue NutritionProduct application. Commit bc72f4cfc3fbe9234e20366223ff27be69e2a93d then corrected expiration-date from dateTime to the valid FHIR SearchParameter type date.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists NutritionProduct as an active resource, making source/nutritionproduct/bundle-NutritionProduct-search-params.xml current build-scope source. OO HCP minutes from 2024-10-28 confirm the expiration-date name for NutritionProduct.instance.expiry and record the 9-0-2 vote. Later NutritionProduct search-parameter status work changed standards status to normative without changing the FHIR-47242 semantics; FHIR-53218 was a later retracted status-prep issue and does not require a separate decision here.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current search-parameter bundle defines ingredient-item with expression NutritionProduct.ingredient.item.concept, consistent with token searching the CodeableReference concept, and expiration-date with expression NutritionProduct.instance.expiry and type date. The previously existing identifier and lot-number searches remain, and the declined characteristics and biologicalSourceEvent searches were not added.
